Prediction construction cost excluded, previous-step IDs assumed available
Per-block FP32 states materialized in hybrid preparation; no compact-state peak-memory claim
Method order shuffled deterministically by seed; repeated independent jobs recommended
Baseline is the same split-block prototype, not a vendor-optimized sparse-attention kernel
